content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be citizens of India. Age, qualification and experience are checked as on the closing date of the application, 12 November 2026. The notice gives only an upper age limit for each post, and says the Institute reserves the right to relax the upper age limit for deserving candidates. Only qualifications from recognised Boards, Universities or Institutes, and relevant post-qualification experience, will be counted. The Institute or the Selection Committee decides whether experience is relevant. Experience: at least five years of relevant experience in corporate business development, institutional sales, executive education, management training, corporate learning and development, or key account management. Must have shown the ability to engage with senior corporate executives and convert business opportunities into revenue-generating assignments. Must have excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills. Desirable: experience in securing executive education, management development, leadership development or customised corporate training programmes. Desirable: existing professional relationships with corporates in India and other major business centres. Desirable: experience working with business schools, management institutes, consulting firms, corporate academies or training organisations. Desirable: a demonstrated track record of achieving business development and revenue targets. Experience: relevant experience in executive education, programme management, training administration, event/programme operations or institutional administration. Desirable: experience in a reputed academic institution, executive education centre, training organization or similar environment. Essential competencies: strong programme/project-management capability; excellent planning and organisational skills; experience in managing conferences, training programmes, executive education or comparable institutional events; ability to handle multiple programmes at the same time; strong service orientation and attention to detail; ability to coordinate across multiple administrative departments; vendor-management and negotiation skills; working knowledge of budgeting and financial administration; strong proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint and digital collaboration tools; ability to work under pressure and handle programmes outside regular working hours when required. Professional experience: at least 15 years of post-qualification experience in construction, estate management, civil engineering works, or maintenance of buildings and infrastructure. This experience must be in Government departments, reputed educational institutions, universities, colleges, public sector undertakings, or commercial organizations of comparable nature and complexity. At least 5 of these years should be in a position carrying Pay Level 10 or above under the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC), or an equivalent pay scale in other organizations.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: For every post except the Corporate Relations Officer, the salary is fixed within the range based on experience and qualification, and the final figure depends on the Selection Committee's recommendation. For the Corporate Relations Officer, the Selection Committee recommends the final monthly pay. Performance is assessed every quarter, but the variable pay is calculated monthly, subject to quarterly KPI verification and approval. The variable pay is performance-linked and not guaranteed. The Institute will share the detailed KPI and Performance Metrics framework at joining. This covers the quarterly KPI scorecard, target-setting, incentive calculation, verification and approval, and the conditions for incentive payment. The Corporate Relations Officer's approved official travel and other eligible expenses are reimbursed under the Institute's applicable rules. The Estate Officer must live on campus and will be given campus accommodation. The applicable licence fee and charges for water, electricity and other utilities, if any, are payable as the Institute prescribes. All posts are fixed-term contracts, which may be extended based on institutional requirements and satisfactory performance. The positions are purely contractual and for a limited period, and no claim can ever be made for regularising them. The notice does not specify the length of the contract.

content_sections.heading: IIM Trichy Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: This post is based in Chennai, with travel to IIM Tiruchirappalli and other locations as needed. The officer builds corporate relationships, identifies the training and executive learning needs of organisations, generates business and secures Executive Education programmes for IIM Tiruchirappalli. The officer acts as a key link with corporates, public sector undertakings, multinational companies, large domestic organisations and other institutions for customised and open-enrolment Executive Education Programmes. The officer reports to the designated authority responsible for Executive Education and corporate engagement. Corporate Relationship Development: identify and build relationships with senior executives, HR heads, L&D heads, business leaders and other decision-makers in Corporates/Government Organizations/MNCs; develop a network of corporate clients; build long-term relationships to generate recurring business. Business Development and Programme Acquisition: identify corporate training needs for MDPs, Leadership Development, Long and Short Duration, Blended Learning and Faculty Development Programmes, Customised Corporate Training Programmes and Consultancy Projects; turn qualified leads into confirmed programmes; understand client requirements, participant profiles, delivery preferences and budgets; work with departments and faculty on proposals. Revenue Generation: achieve quarterly targets for confirmed programmes and revenue, as approved by the Institute; build a sustainable pipeline and repeat engagements; support negotiations, proposal submission, commercial discussions and closure. Programme Coordination: coordinate with the Dean (CR & FA), the Chairperson - Executive Education, faculty and administrative departments for handover and delivery; keep in touch with clients from first enquiry to confirmation and beyond; monitor client feedback. Market Intelligence and Reporting: track corporate learning requirements, industry trends and competing offerings; keep a structured database of clients, leads, proposals, follow-ups and conversions; submit monthly progress reports and quarterly performance reports. Performance is assessed quarterly on revenue from confirmed programmes, the number and value of new programmes, lead conversion, new accounts and repeat business, pipeline quality and timely follow-up, and client satisfaction, coordination and quality of reporting. The Manager–EEC is responsible for the end-to-end operational planning, coordination and delivery of Executive Education and Consulting programmes once an assignment is confirmed. The role focuses on programme operations, logistics, administration, financial coordination, service quality and team management. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIM Trichy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies, one for each of the 8 non-teaching posts. Two posts are at Chennai (Corporate Relations Officer and Assistant Manager – Programme and Campus Operations), and six are at the Tiruchirappalli Main Campus.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIM Trichy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 12 November 2026, 5.00 pm. Online applications open on 23 October 2026 at 11.00 am.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IIM Trichy non-teaching posts?
faq.answer: Each post has its own requirement. For example, the Estate Officer needs a Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering with at least 50% marks and 15 years' experience. The Editorial Assistant needs post graduation in any field with at least second class (50% marks).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IIM Trichy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 55 years for the Corporate Relations Officer, Manager – Executive Education and Consulting and Estate Officer. It is 50 years for both Assistant Manager posts and 40 years for the IT Support Engineer, Editorial Assistant and Hindi Supervisor, as on the closing date. The Institute reserves the right to relax the upper age limit for deserving candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for IIM Trichy non-teaching posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly salary ranges from Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 40,000/- for the Editorial Assistant and Hindi Supervisor, up to Rs. 75,000/- to Rs. 90,000/- for the Manager – EEC and Estate Officer. The Corporate Relations Officer gets a fixed ₹70,000 to ₹80,000 plus variable pay of up to ₹70,000 to ₹80,000 a month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for IIM Trichy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through www.iimtrichy.ac.in/en/careers-non-teaching, upload your documents, photograph and signature, and submit by 12 November 2026 (5.00 pm). Applications sent any other way will not be considered, and you do not need to send a hard copy unless asked.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIM Trichy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates go through a selection process that may include a written test/skill test and an interview. The Institute or the Selection Committee decides how candidates are shortlisted and the mode and stages of selection.

faq.question: Q8. Are the IIM Trichy non-teaching posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. All the posts are on a fixed-term contract, which may be extended based on institutional requirements and satisfactory performance. No claim can ever be made for regularising these positions.

faq.question: Q9. Is certification mandatory for the IIM Trichy IT Support Engineer post?
faq.answer: CCNP / BCNE / Fortinet NSE Level 3 or higher is mandatory, and RHCE/MCSE is preferred. The certification is not essential for candidates with 3+ years of L3 Level hands-on network and security experience directly with the OEMs, network and security MNCs or national-level institutes the notice lists.

faq.question: Q10. Does the IIM Trichy Estate Officer get campus accommodation?
faq.answer: Yes. The Estate Officer must live on campus and will be given campus accommodation. The applicable licence fee and utility charges are payable as the Institute prescribes.
